title: +79% upside: $HQ $11.44 to $20.50, the quantum software stock analysts just started covering
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Horizon Quantum's $20.50 target is the average of two new Buy-rated targets: $20 from Needham and $21 from Craig-Hallum. From about $11.44, reaching it would take roughly a 79% gain. The Singapore-based company builds software tools that make it easier to write applications for quantum computers. Support comes from that long-term software opportunity, the new analyst coverage, and recent partnership and acquisition activity. The risks are a near-zero revenue base, heavy operating losses, dilution since its SPAC listing and extreme share-price volatility. This is a target, not a promise.

Full analysis: https://tickeron.com/blogs/horizon-quantum-holdings-ltd-hq-analyzing-the-path-to-79-upside-33155/
